title: Turn concept art into a functional game UI

author: Unity
description:
Learn how to prototype a game UI using Unity UI Toolkit and an AI agent directly through the Unity CLI!

In this tutorial, we start from concept art and a short brief, and watch an AI agent build a fully functional main menu inside the Unity Editor - all driven from the terminal.

What you’ll learn: 
✔️ The agent brief workflow: How to brief, guide, and steer an AI agent as it builds UI screens from concept art.
✔️ Under the hood: How the Pipeline package, official Unity agent skills, and custom CLI commands work together.
✔️ Automated feedback loops: How to run Play mode UI tests and capture Game view screenshots via the command line so the agent can inspect, verify, and iterate on its own work.
✔️ The core agent loop: Master the Observe ➔ Perceive ➔ Plan ➔ Act cycle to successfully delegate complex tasks while retaining full control over the output.

Prerequisites and setup: 
🔹 Unity 6.x (built and tested on 6000.5.10f1)
🔹 Unity CLI
🔹 Unity Agent Skills: https://github.com/Unity-Tec
